name: Craftsman's Writ: Dusky Bracers

aliases: what do i need for this writ
faq.answer: The order requests one pair of Dusky Bracers to satisfy the customer's trade agreement.
faq.q: What is requested in this writ?

aliases: can i give this writ away
faq.answer: Yes. The text denotes that the document is transferable, meaning anyone holding it may fulfill the delivery.
faq.q: Can someone else fulfill this writ?

faq.answer: You must hold the writ itself when delivering the bracers to the marked location to receive payment.
faq.q: What is needed to claim payment?

sections.body: A customer has placed an order for a pair of Dusky Bracers, scribbled out in faded ink across this transferable parchment. The note outlines both the promised payment and where the shipment must go. Whoever carries the writ and delivers the armor can claim the coin for the work.
sections.title: A Transferable Order

summary: A trade order written in faded ink calls for a pair of Dusky Bracers to be delivered to a marked customer. The transferable document promises payment upon arrival, so long as the parchment remains in your hands.
attribution: In-game quest text: Craftsman's Writ: Dusky Bracers
